\title{Fake Results on Imaginary Oracles\\with a Second Line}

\begin{abstract}
We study imaginary oracles and prove that an adversary making $q$ queries wins with probability at most $q^2/2^n$. Costs are 50\% lower than before, \& the proof is \emph{short}. % a comment with $unbalanced math
\end{abstract}
